title: Remove Launch start decision detail flat aliases
summary: Removed two Launch start-decision display-helper compatibility aliases from the flat window surface while preserving the mediaPipelineLaunchView namespace contract.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in the touched Launch scope domain without changing backend mutation, media policy, command routing, source media handling, or pending-publish behavior.
behavior_before: Launch start-decision summary/detail helper functions were available both through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView and direct flat window.launchStartDecision* aliases.
behavior_after: Launch start-decision summary/detail helper functions remain available through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView only; direct flat window.launchStartDecisionSummaryLines and window.launchStartDecisionDetailLines aliases are no longer exported. Rows/status remain flat because Launch command-button and browser smoke consumers still intentionally use them.
tests_added: Extended existing Local API WebView static assertions to require Launch start-decision summary/detail namespace exports and reject the removed flat aliases.
rollback_plan: Restore the two Launch start-decision summary/detail flat window assignments in launchView.js, revert the namespace/no-flat test assertions and docs/generated artifacts, refresh summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView validation ladder.
